scientific_integrity: Primary classification 37A30 concerns the proved quantitative ergodic-average law for a singular observable of the uniquely ergodic 2-adic adding machine. Its construction comes from a resonant proportional-delay recurrence (also naturally 39A30); finite verifier is supplemental, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonautonomous dyadic delay and resonant instantaneous multiplier; statistical occupation laws only, with no extension to other ratios or general invariant-measure interpretation. Historical priority remains open to independently checked sources.
title: Dyadic occupation laws and a sharp moment transition in resonant proportional-delay dynamics
